conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Your bank’s a mess! My credit card statement shows a ₹15,000 charge I never made!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s concerning Sir. Can you confirm the date and merchant of the transaction?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s from two days ago, some online store. I didn’t buy anything!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you. This looks like a potential fraud. I’ll block your card and initiate a chargeback request.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: You better refund me fast! This is unacceptable!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand your frustration. The chargeback is filed, and you’ll see the refund in 7-10 days.
